answer.book: Louis Du Moulin's Fasciculus epistolarum Latinè & Gallicè (1676), one work: front matter (an Overbury dedication, an epistola dedicatoria, a catalogue of letters and an admonitio), then thirteen numbered letters in Latin and French, then corrigenda.
